verdicts.reason: A keeps the pink chevron panel behind the copy so EXPAND / YOUR SPACE stays legible and in the right order, but the headline and arrow rows run into the right edge with no margin, the panel cuts through the chairs, a small zigzag fragment floats on its own, and the bottom third is empty floor. B scrambles the reading order to 'YOUR SPACE / EXPAND' and puts white text straight onto the busy photo, so thin EXPAND nearly disappears on the light wall and lamps. Its pink block is cut off, holds no text, and floats mid-canvas, and the zigzag sits cramped in the bottom-left corner, so B loses both the brand panel and the hierarchy.
